text:
Alex: Quick sync: our reserved GPU commitments for eu-west look risky if hosted qps stays +15% MoM. Can we run sensitivity to usage drivers (embedding spikes, long chat sessions, quantization adoption)?

Maria: Agree. I can run demand-profile sweep but need assumptions for quantization adoption timeline. Do we assume 50% of models switch to int8 by Q3?

Samir: We saw an 18% embedding burst last week from one user. I recommend modeling 3 scenarios: base, high-burst (90th perc), and adaptive quantization uptake.

Alex: Finance wants cost delta vs on-demand vs committed. @finance-bot can you pull last 3 months billed on GPUs? per-region?

finance-bot: Pulled CSV to /mnt/finance/gpu_billing_mar_2026.csv — total hosted GPU spend $1.2M last 90d. Check permissions.

Maria: Thanks. I'll use that for normalization. Also include reserved capacity lead times: 8-12 weeks for procurement.

Samir: We should include routing fallback latency SLO degradation costs — see incident last month. If reserved exhausted, we pay more via bursting.

Alex: Plan: Maria to run sweep scenarios + sensitivity to quant adoption and embedding task distribution by EOD Wed. Samir to provide burst examples & tail QPS. I'll prep a short deck for leadership.

Maria: :thumbsup: Starting now. Will put results in #eng-infra-reports and ping here.

Samir: Attached quick snippet of the synthetic profile I'll use:

```
# profile example
base_qps = 1200
burst_qps = 2800  # 5% probability per day
avg_seq = 64
embedding_share = 0.12
```

Priya: Priya: forwarded two customer job IDs to you, Alex: 98765 and 99102 — they were throttled last week.

Maria: Got them, thx. Will include in burst sample.

Alex: Ok will check in Thurs with preliminary numbers. Tagging @Kevin to review procurement timelines.

Kevin: procurement lead times confirmed: 10 weeks standard, 6 weeks if pushing priority, cost delta for expedited ~12%.

Maria: Noted.

Alex: cool, thanks all. cc: @eng-sre if we need emergency scaling playbook.
